title: Reasoning-Aware Training for Time Series Forecasting

claim.summary: STRIDE distills teacher-generated temporal reasoning into a small language model and jointly trains its projected hidden-state prior with a numerical forecasting foundation model.

modules.name: Temporal reasoning distillation into the language model
modules.scope_reason: A teacher produces training reasoning from historical/future training windows and events; the student learns reasoning from historical inputs with causal language modelling.
evidence_locators: PDF p.5; passage beginning "3.3. Reference Reasoning Generation and Distillation"

modules.name: Joint language-numerical latent fusion
modules.scope_reason: Mean-pooled LLM hidden states are projected into the TSFM embedding space; quantile and language losses update the projection, TSFM and LLM LoRA.
evidence_locators: PDF p.5; passage beginning "3.4. Cross-Modal Fusion and End-to-End Training"
